overloads.semanticRole: SET PICTURE TO PASTEBOARD clears the pasteboard and puts a copy of the picture passed in picture into it.

constraints: Clears the pasteboard before placing picture; the picture is stored in its native format (JPEG, TIFF, PNG, etc.) and can be retrieved with GET PICTURE FROM PASTEBOARD or GET PASTEBOARD DATA (e.g. "com.4d.private.picture.gif").
